input: An in-process registered, unchanged CompiledProjectGraph snapshot. Caller-created clones and forged graph metadata are rejected by the existing snapshot assertion.
projection: Retain each legacy Interface request/result field with its authored operation reference, type, required flag and exact source pointer. Equal field names in distinct endpoints remain distinct, even when their types are equal.
ambiguity: A legacy Interface field name with more than one endpoint candidate is ambiguous. Report all candidates in stable order and whether their type and required declarations differ. Never select first or last by source order.
mapping_uses: For each untyped legacy Mapping source_field and target_field pointing to an Interface, report the exact Mapping field source pointer, endpoint role, all candidates and resolved versus ambiguous scope. A single candidate resolves field identity only, not a typed successor, request/result compatibility, or migration authority.
unsupported: Typed Interface source is explicitly rejected until an exact supported successor is implemented. Typed Mappings are separately listed as not inspected by this legacy-field inspector, never silently counted as checked.
evidence: Bind the report to the checked graph certificate digest, source manifest identity and definition hash; hash the complete deterministic report and return recursively frozen owned data.
